page.noscript: strudelmixr needs JavaScript to make music. Please turn on JavaScript in your browser.

bpm.label: Tempo in BPM
bpm.dragTitle: Drag up or down, or click to type

templatesDialog.replaceNotice: This replaces your current project – press Undo ({shortcut}) to get it back.

start.templatesText: One click and you'll hear music right away. Then change whatever you like.
start.emptyHeading: What would you like to start with?
start.emptyText: Pick your first sound – you can add more tracks any time.

onboarding.title: Music from building blocks
onboarding.intro: Stack sounds, rhythms and effects like on a mixing desk. strudelmixr turns them into {strudel} code live – you hear every change instantly and pick up the code along the way.
onboarding.tip: Tip: {key} starts and stops the music. Nothing can break – you can undo everything.

workspace.newTrackGroup: Add a new track with a sound
workspace.chooseSoundTitle: What should this track sound like?

trackInspector.title: Track “{name}”
trackInspector.subtitle: Applies to every block on this track.
trackInspector.name: Name
trackInspector.soloHint: – hear only this track (or these tracks)

inspector.noParams: This block has no settings – it just works. Press Play and give it a listen!

emptyInspector.step1Text: Its settings show up here – grids, sliders, sounds.
emptyInspector.step2Text: Rhythms and effects shape the track from left to right.
emptyInspector.step3Text: Press Play or the space bar. You'll hear every change instantly.

picker.noResults: Nothing found – try a different word.

grid.drumHint: Click the boxes or drag across them. Each column is one sixteenth note.
grid.noteHint: Click to set a note, drag its right edge to hold it longer (or Shift+→/←). Top = high, stack notes for chords.

code.title: Strudel code
code.subtitle: Your song as code – edit it and the blocks follow.
code.empty: No code yet – add a track, or simply type Strudel code here.
code.footer: Every block becomes a function like {example}. Edit the code right here – or open it in Strudel.
code.placeholder: // Type Strudel code here, e.g. $: s("bd*4")

status.linkedPlaying: Your code is playing – the blocks follow
status.liveTooltip: This code is playing right now

codeMode.syntax: Syntax error in line {line}. The last working version keeps playing, the blocks stay as they were.
codeMode.noPattern: There’s no pattern here that could become blocks yet. The blocks stay as they were.
codeMode.arrangement: This song structure can’t be shown as blocks (every track needs the same sections). The blocks stay as they were.
codeMode.error: This code can’t be turned into blocks. The blocks stay as they were.
codeMode.backTooltip: Discard your code changes and use the blocks again

aligned.zero: Code tidied up to match the blocks.
aligned.one: Code tidied up to match the blocks – {count} sound was swapped for a free one.
aligned.other: Code tidied up to match the blocks – {count} sounds were swapped for free ones.

code.replaced: The blocks changed – your code draft was replaced.

import.title: Import Strudel code
import.subtitle: Paste a piece from strudel.cc, a share link or open a file – you'll get tracks and blocks you can keep editing.
import.placeholder:
Paste code here, for example:

setcpm(30)
$: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd")
$: note("c3 eb3 g3").s("sawtooth").lpf(800)
import.codeHint: {shortcut} opens it as a new project
import.addToProjectHint: Adds the tracks to your project – your tempo stays the same.
import.replaceNotice: Replaces your current project – Undo ({shortcut}) brings it back.
import.fileWrongType: “{name}” can't be imported – please use a .js, .txt or .strudel file.
import.fileTooLarge: “{name}” is too big to be a Strudel piece.
import.dropText: Strudel code as a .js, .txt or .strudel file

start.heading: Already have Strudel code?
start.text: Found something you like on strudel.cc? Bring it in and keep working on it with blocks.
start.buttonHint: Paste code, a link or open a file

preview.emptyText: As soon as you paste some code, you'll see the tempo, the tracks and their blocks.
preview.preludeHint: Runs before all tracks – you can edit it later.
preview.noTracksText: This code doesn't play anything we could turn into tracks. Strudel pieces usually contain lines like $: s("bd sd").

notes.heading: Good to know
notes.substitutedHint: Not available here, so we picked the closest match.
notes.keptAsCodeHint: There's no block for this yet – it still plays, and you can edit it as code.
notes.droppedHint: Mostly visuals or controls that don't work here.
notes.convertedHint: Translated so you can edit it with the usual controls.
notes.infoHint: Nothing to do – just so you know.

error.title: This code can't be read yet
error.unknown: Something in this code got the importer confused.
error.help: Was the whole piece copied? A missing bracket or quote at the end is the most common cause.
error.linkInvalid: This link doesn't contain any code we can read. Copy the code from the editor on strudel.cc instead.

prelude.title: Setup code
prelude.explain: Runs before all tracks – this is where your own functions and constants live.
prelude.emptyHint: Empty setup code isn't saved – use “Remove setup code” to get rid of it.

noteGrid.repeatFirst: Repeat bar 1 in the empty bars

barsRemoved.one: Shortened – {count} note in the removed bars is gone
barsRemoved.other: Shortened – {count} notes in the removed bars are gone

noteGrid.resize: Drag to make the note longer or shorter

song.createHint: Arrange your tracks into sections like intro, verse and drop – each track on or off per section.
song.tip: Click cells to switch a track on or off in a section – drag to paint.
song.variantAddTooltip: Add a variation for this section
song.variantHint: Added to the track only in this section – e.g. .lpf(800) for a muffled sound or .gain(0.5) for quieter.

samples.title: Your samples
samples.subtitle: Drop in your own sounds – each slot becomes a Strudel sound you can play with s("name"), variations with s("name:1").
samples.emptySlot: Still empty – drop audio files here.

missing.one: “{file}” is missing – drop it here to bring it back.
missing.other: {count} files are missing (e.g. “{file}”) – drop them here to bring them back.

samples.dropHint: WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC … or a whole folder: every subfolder becomes a sound.
samples.privacy: Your files stay on this device – nothing is uploaded. When using other people's samples, make sure you're allowed to.
samples.dropOverlayText: Each file becomes a sound – folders become one sound with variations.

missingHint.one: {count} sample file isn't included. Drop it in later to hear it.
missingHint.other: {count} sample files aren't included. Drop them in later to hear them.

projectFile.dropAnyText: Projects (.zip, .json), samples (audio files or folders), MIDI files (.mid) or Strudel code (.js, .txt).

errors.invalid: This project file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.notJson: This file isn't a project file (no valid JSON).
errors.notProject: This JSON file isn't a strudelmixr project.
errors.version: This project was saved with a newer strudelmixr version.
errors.notZip: This file isn't a ZIP archive.
errors.zipUnsupported: This ZIP uses a format we can't read (e.g. password or very large archives).
errors.zipBroken: This ZIP archive seems to be damaged.
errors.emptyZip: There's no project or audio file in this ZIP.
errors.unknownFile: “{name}” can't be used here – drop projects, audio files or Strudel code.
errors.exportFailed: The project couldn't be packed – please try again.

songBar.label: Song playback
songBar.sections: Sections – click to play from there
